snippet.title: Celia's Stupid Romhack - With Lyrics! (Demo 2 Trailer!)
snippet.description:
The next major demo of Celia's Stupid Romhack is ready!

This is a Comedy Puzzle Hack made for folks who are big fans of the Pokemon franchise. This next demo adds content up through Celadon City!

Play with friends! Every line of dialogue is quirky and fun, and every Pokemon has been changed in some way. I strongly recommend completing the Pokedex while you play!

Saves should be compatible with the previous version!

Official Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/wFmHfgz3JA

Download Link: https://www.hackdex.app/hack/celias-stupid-romhack

Lyrics:
Young man! 
When your work's taken down, I said 
Young man! 
Don't go wearin' a frown, lookin' 
Somewhere! 
All around the new town, we can 
Help - you - have - a - good time 

[boom boom boom boom boom] 

It's fun to challenge the- 
D - M - C - A 
It's fun to challenge the- 
D - M - C - A

Cuz there's so many things
fandoms made to enjoy

(but) Corporate overlords made their choice

We're not afraid of the- 
D - M - C - A 
We stand together for
Free-dom to play

Cuz you need to be free!
Shouldn't have to conceal!

To create whatever you feel!

Thank you so much to kiloPascal for singing, to Swiwious for doing audio production, and to OniLinkPlus for editing the video!

OniLinkPlus - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTOfSONApVkDA1-9kxLw0fQ
